method: exact density-matrix probabilities (no sampling, no seeds)
noise_model: sx, x: depolarizing or X-flip; cx: two-qubit depolarizing or single-qubit X on either qubit; rz error-free (main results). Readout: symmetric, applied exactly to the ideal distribution.
semiclassical_form: deferred measurement (all measurements at the end)
bit_convention: x = sum_j c[j] 2^j, c[0] least significant
